rows.source: FillInput(): words[0] = FloatEdges[tid%12]; words[1] = FloatEdges[(tid/12 + tid*7)%12] ^ (tid&4 ? 0x80000000 : 0); words[2] = 0xabcd0000 | HalfEdges[tid%12]; words[3] = 0x12340000 | (HalfEdges[(tid/12 + tid*5)%12] ^ (tid&8 ? 0x8000 : 0))

notes: The test loads inputs 2 and 3 into v14 and v15 (not v6, v7); the body never reads v6/v7, so pre copies v6 -> v14 and v7 -> v15. v10 = 0 is the prologue's accumulator init (template also zeroes it).
The body saves EXEC in s30 before each v_cmpx and restores it with s_mov_b32 exec_lo, s30 (words 59, 67), so EXEC is all-ones at the end; no post needed.
Result column 0 is a bitmask (bits 0..8, one per compare); Check() asserts all 9 bits.
